title: Hanover Bancorp Approves New Share Repurchase Program
summary: MINEOLA, N.Y., Aug. 26, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Hanover Bancorp, Inc. (NASDAQ: HNVR) (the “Company”), parent company of Hanover Community Bank (the “Bank”), announced today that its Board of Directors has approved a new Share Repurchase Program. Under this program, which will expire on August 17, 2027, the Company may repurchase up to 370,000 shares, or approximately 5% of its outstanding common stock.
